people.body: Each worker has a single profile that doubles as their self-service hub: payslips, leave balances, reviews, wellbeing prompts, and notifications, all in one place. The org chart builds itself from who reports to whom, so it is never a stale slide deck — reorganise a team and it simply relayouts.

multiorg.title: Belong to more than one organisation
multiorg.body: Sign in once and see every organisation you belong to at the same time — a company, a department, a peer organisation, a working group — with no separate switcher to click through. Each membership carries its own role, so being a staff partner in one team and an ordinary member of another is one sign-in, not two accounts.
